name: batch
title: Batch job
description: Splits work into pieces and spreads them over the pool: rendering frames, encoding videos, crunching data. Each piece gets SYS1_SHARD_INDEX and SYS1_SHARD_COUNT and writes its results to /output; collect them all into one folder when it's done.
